name: pey.filesystem
description: User-device file access as a platform capability over a swappable environment adapter (browser File System Access today): pick files/folders, list Markdown entries, read and write; browser-side shadow drafts for unsaved device edits

provides.name: pey.filesystem.service
provides.description: Markdown-focused file-entry operations over the plugin's environment adapter (BrowserEnvironmentAdapter by default, selectable by configuration). Entries carry either a FileSystem handle or a plain File.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Reports which environment pickers exist and whether picked entries can be written back.
methods.returns: { directoryPicker: boolean, filePicker: boolean, writable: boolean }

methods.name: pickDirectory
methods.description: Opens the environment directory picker and returns the chosen folder as an entry. Null when no picker is available or the user cancels.
methods.returns: { name: string, path: string, handle: FileSystemDirectoryHandle } | null

methods.name: pickFile
methods.description: Opens the environment file picker and returns the chosen file as an entry. Null when no picker is available or the user cancels.
methods.returns: { name: string, path: string, handle: FileSystemFileHandle } | null

methods.name: listDirectory
methods.description: Walks a picked directory recursively through the environment adapter and returns every Markdown entry with its relative path and own file handle. Flat list; other files are skipped.

params.name: directory
params.type: object — picked directory entry ({ name, path, handle }) or a raw directory handle

methods.returns: { name: string, path: string, handle: FileSystemFileHandle }[]

methods.name: collectEntries
methods.description: Filters a flat file list (e.g. from a webkitdirectory input) down to Markdown entries, keeping each file for reading.

params.name: files
params.type: Array<File-like> — each with name, text() and optional webkitRelativePath

methods.returns: { name: string, path: string, file: File-like }[]

methods.name: readEntry
methods.description: Reads entry text through the adapter (with a read-permission round-trip) or its plain file. Strips a leading byte-order mark.

params.name: entry
params.type: { name: string, path: string, handle?: FileSystemFileHandle, file?: File-like }

methods.name: writeEntry
methods.description: Writes content through the entry handle (with a readwrite-permission round-trip). Null when the entry has no writable handle — the caller falls back (e.g. to a download).

params.name: entry
params.type: { name: string, path: string, handle?: FileSystemFileHandle }

methods.name: saveShadow
methods.description: Persists a browser-side working copy of a device entry (disk bytes untouched): the disk content at open (base) plus the current draft.

params.name: root
params.type: string — folder label the entry was opened from

params.name: base
params.type: string — disk content the draft started from

methods.returns: { root: string, path: string, updatedAt: number }

methods.name: readShadow
methods.description: Reads the stored working copy for an entry, or null when none exists.

params.name: root
params.type: string — folder label the entry was opened from

methods.returns: { root: string, path: string, base: string, draft: string, updatedAt: number } | null

methods.name: clearShadow
methods.description: Deletes the stored working copy (e.g. after an explicit disk save made it redundant).

params.name: root
params.type: string — folder label the entry was opened from
